aboutPage.title: About Rechnuvio
aboutPage.subtitle: Rechnuvio was founded on a simple yet uncompromising principle: software utilities should run in your browser sandbox, without sending sensitive data, confidential files, or API payloads to remote third-party servers.
aboutPage.missionP1: Every day, millions of developers and professionals paste confidential JSON credentials, database connection strings, financial spreadsheets, and proprietary images into online formatting tools. Many of these legacy websites log, store, and transmit your data to backend APIs.
aboutPage.missionP2: Rechnuvio changes that standard. By leveraging modern WebAssembly, Web Crypto, the HTML5 Canvas API, and client-side JavaScript compilers, 100% of the computations execute locally inside your browser memory.
aboutPage.pillar1Desc: Files and clipboard inputs never leave your device. All parsing, compression, and conversion happens in memory.
aboutPage.pillar2Desc: No server round-trips. Experience instantaneous real-time updates as you type or adjust parameters.
aboutPage.pillar3Desc: 492 tools completely unrestricted. No subscription paywalls, no forced sign-ups, and no artificial daily limits.

privacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicyPage.s1Desc: At Rechnuvio, we believe privacy is a fundamental human right. Our tools are engineered to execute client-side in your web browser. We do not transmit, collect, log, or sell any text, files, images, PDFs, JSON documents, or code you process through our tools.
privacyPolicyPage.s2Desc: When you upload an image, convert a CSV file, format JSON, or generate a PDF, that file is loaded strictly into your device's RAM memory using standard HTML5 FileReader, WebAssembly, and Canvas APIs. It never traverses the internet to our servers.
privacyPolicyPage.s3Desc: We use minimal, privacy-respecting analytics to monitor aggregate website traffic, page view counts, and performance uptime. We do not use third-party tracking pixels or fingerprinting techniques.
privacyPolicyPage.s4Desc: If you have questions regarding this privacy policy or our technical architecture, please contact us via our Contact Page.

termsOfServicePage.title: Terms of Service
termsOfServicePage.s1Desc: By accessing and using Rechnuvio, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our utilities.
termsOfServicePage.s2Desc: You are free to use all tools for personal, commercial, educational, and professional purposes. You agree not to attempt to reverse engineer, disrupt, overload, or exploit the platform through automated scraping or malicious denial of service.
termsOfServicePage.s3Desc: Rechnuvio is provided on an 'AS IS' and 'AS AVAILABLE' basis without warranties of any kind. While we strive for absolute accuracy in all mathematical, formatting, and conversion calculations, you are advised to verify critical outputs before production deployment.

holidaysList.heading: US federal holidays and observances in {year}

guide.printableCalendarDesc: This {year} calendar shows every month with weekends shaded and holidays highlighted. Choose US federal holidays, with observed days for holidays on weekends, or UK bank holidays for England and Wales, and add observances such as Easter and Halloween if you like. Start weeks on Sunday or Monday, show ISO week numbers, and download a vector PDF for US Letter or A4 with the whole year on one page or 12 monthly pages.
guide.howToPrintStep1: The year is set to {year}. Choose Whole year for a one-page calendar or 12 months for monthly pages.
guide.howToPrintStep2: Pick the holidays (US, UK or none), whether to include observances, and Sunday or Monday as the first day of the week.
guide.howToPrintStep3: Choose paper size, orientation and colour. Add ISO week numbers or notes lines if you need them.
guide.howToPrintStep4: Select Download PDF, or Print to send it straight to your printer.
guide.atAGlancePoint1: {year} starts on a Thursday and ends on a Thursday. It is not a leap year: it has 365 days and February has 28.
guide.atAGlancePoint2: Choose a Monday start for ISO week numbers, used for work planning in Europe; the US convention is a Sunday start.
guide.atAGlancePoint3: Federal holidays falling on a weekend are marked on their observed weekday, when most offices close.
guide.atAGlancePoint4: For wall calendars, use landscape monthly pages with notes; for a desk or fridge, the whole-year page fits on one sheet.
guide.whyUseVectorDesc: Sharp lines and text at any size, on US Letter or A4, portrait or landscape.
guide.whyUseHolidaysDesc: US federal holidays with observed days, or UK bank holidays with substitute days, plus optional observances.
guide.whyUseLayoutDesc: Whole year on one page or 12 monthly pages with notes lines, Sunday or Monday start, ISO week numbers and 5 colours.
guide.whyUseNoSignupDesc: Generated on your device in a second. Nothing to install and no email required.
guide.usePlanningDesc: Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year at a glance.
guide.useRemainingDesc: Print just the monthly pages you still need.
guide.useSchoolDesc: Track the 2026–27 school year alongside the 2027 calendar.
guide.useOfficeDesc: ISO week numbers and a Monday start.
guide.dateCalcDesc: Planning around dates? Count working days with the business days calculator, find the gap between two dates with days between dates, or count down to Christmas and the New Year.
guide.exampleHeading: Example: the rest of {year} on the fridge
guide.exampleDesc: Choose 12 months, United States and US Letter portrait. Print October, November and December from the PDF to plan the holiday season, with Thanksgiving on November 26 and Christmas Day on Friday, December 25.
guide.expectHeading: What to expect from the result
guide.expectDesc: Holidays cover US federal holidays and bank holidays in England and Wales. State, school and religious holidays outside the observance list are not included, and future government changes to holidays may not be reflected.

faqs.heading: {year} Calendar questions
faqs.a1: Yes. Download and print the PDF as often as you like. No sign-up or watermark.
faqs.q2: Which public holidays are nationwide in Germany in {year}?
faqs.a2: Nine statutory public holidays apply across all 16 federal states: New Year's Day (Jan 1), Good Friday (Apr 3), Easter Monday (Apr 6), Labour Day (May 1), Ascension Day (May 14), Whit Monday (May 25), Day of German Unity (Oct 3), and Christmas Day & Boxing Day (Dec 25/26). Regional holidays such as Corpus Christi or Reformation Day depend on the specific state.
faqs.q3: What day does {year} start and end on?
faqs.a3: January 1, {year} was a Thursday and December 31, {year} is a Thursday. {year} is not a leap year.
faqs.q4: Can I print a 2027 calendar too?
faqs.a4: Yes. Change the year to 2027, or open the 2027 calendar page.
faqs.q5: Can I start the week on Monday?
faqs.a5: Yes. Choose Monday under Week starts on. You can also show ISO week numbers.
faqs.q6: How can I best use German bridging days in {year}?
faqs.a6: Thursday holidays such as Ascension Day (May 14) and Corpus Christi (Jun 4) are ideal: 1 vacation day on Friday gives 4 consecutive days off. New Year's Day also falls on a Thursday. Around Easter, 4 to 8 vacation days yield 10 to 16 consecutive days off.
